name: Floyd the Droid
summary: Floyd the Droid takes you into London's sewers, where you play as a droid named Floyd tasked with restoring order. Your mission is to clean the tunnels and eliminate the creatures living there before moving on to other cities. Before each job you decide how Floyd should move and react by programming sequences of actions. You can also switch him to automatic mode and watch as he tries to handle the chaos on his own, or take full control in manual mode. The game blends tactics, programming, and action into a unique experience.
